Kris Hermie, CFA Managing Director | CIO Kris has a Master in Business Administration and obtained his CFA title in 2002. He started his career at bank Corluy in 1998 as an analyst and has since worked as a fund manager at Dexia Asset Management, Petercam and NN Investment Partners (ING Investment Management), managing global dividend funds. His investment style is highly value-oriented, with a 2011 Lipper Award in the United States (Best Global Large Cap Value Fund over 5 years). Outside Value Square, he enjoys spending family time with his wife and three daughters, is an avid runner and an active crossfit practitioner. Kris is a member of the Board of Directors.
